================================================================================
Base-prefixed number with a variable
================================================================================

h=ff; x=$((16#$h))
echo 16#$h

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (variable_assignment
    (variable_name)
    (word))
  (variable_assignment
    (variable_name)
    (arithmetic_expansion
      (number
        (simple_expansion
          (variable_name)))))
  (command
    (command_name
      (word))
    (number
      (simple_expansion
        (variable_name)))))

================================================================================
Base-prefixed number with a literal or braced variable
================================================================================

x=$((16#ff))
echo 16#${h}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (variable_assignment
    (variable_name)
    (arithmetic_expansion
      (number)))
  (command
    (command_name
      (word))
    (number
      (expansion
        (variable_name)))))
